title: M5GFX #432: I2C FIFO depth from hal/i2c_ll.h on ESP-IDF 6.0+ (code-level review)

execution.environment: macOS arm64; Apple clang 21.0.0; ESP-IDF headers fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com for v5.3/v5.4.3/v5.5.4/v6.0/v6.0.3/v6.1.1/v6.3-dev; no local ESP-IDF 6.x toolchain

checks.detail: 1 file, +5/-0 in src/lgfx/v1/platforms/esp32/common.inl (getFifoLen only); head c90dda6 on develop 452c15b, single commit, MERGEABLE

30-row probe of soc_caps.h and hal/i2c_ll.h: SOC_I2C_FIFO_LEN/SOC_LP_I2C_FIFO_LEN present in v5.3/v5.4.3/v5.5.4 and absent from v6.0/v6.0.3/v6.1.1/v6.3-dev; I2C_LL_FIFO_LEN/I2C_LL_LP_FIFO_LEN absent in all 5.x and present in all 6.x (header moved to components/esp_hal_i2c/<chip>/include/hal/, include name unchanged)
6.x values equal 5.x: C5/C6/P4 LP 16 + HP 32, C2 HP 16, ESP32 HP 32; C5 does not exist in v5.3

extracted isLpPort/getFifoLen from head compiled with the real macro sets under -Wall -Wextra -Werror: C5/C6 HP 32 LP 16, P4 port0/1 32 port2 16, C2 16, C6 on 5.5.4 32/16, ESP32 on 5.5.4 32; no unused-parameter warning for chips without an LP port
same harness on base develop: LP port 32 and C2 32 on 6.0.3 (the reported regression), C6 on 5.5.4 still 32/16
5.x headers define SOC_* and no I2C_LL_* at all, so the new #elif is dead code there; base and head produce the same value on every 5.x scenario

replay of ((length-1)%limit)+1: with limit 32 the first chunk exceeds 16 from 17 bytes up (81 of the 9..97 lengths), matching the reported C5/C6 boundary at 18 and P4 boundary at 17; with limit 16 every length 9..97 splits into chunks <=16 and the chunks sum to the original length

IDFBuild.yml 6.x jobs are esp32/esp32s3 at 6.0.2 only; C5 5.5.2, C6 5.4.3, P4 5.4.3, C61 5.5.2. ArduinoBuild.yml tops out at core 3.3.0 (ESP-IDF 5.5.0). The new LP #elif is never compiled in CI. Non-blocking suggestion: add esp32c6 and esp32c2 at 6.0.2.

a chip with an LP port but neither LP macro would fall into the #else and silently return the HP depth - the same class of bug this PR fixes. Unreachable with 5.4..6.3-dev; suggestion is an #error inside the LGFX_LP_I2C_NUM > 0 branch.
checks on head c90dda6 pass; the 5.4.3/5.5.4 C5/C6/P4 jobs keep compiling the unchanged 5.x branch
no ToughC5 / Nesso N1 / Tab5 hardware here; the author's NFC detection counts and test_UnitNFC_ToughC5 181/181 were not reproduced

the change only takes effect when built with ESP-IDF 6.x and the local build chain is 5.4/5.5 only (no 6.x toolchain or image, no Docker image pulled). Under 5.x the new branch is preprocessed out, so base and head binaries are identical and a virtual device cannot show a difference. Device Service has nesso-n1 (C6) and tab5 (P4) profiles but no confirmed model that observes LP I2C FIFO overflow.
no ESP32-C2 hardware and no 6.x build; only the header value (I2C_LL_FIFO_LEN 16) and the branch evaluation are covered
the author's native builds for IDF 5.4.4 / 5.5.4 / 6.0.3 / 6.1 were not rerun here

notes: PR left OPEN; one Japanese comment posted (https://github.com/m5stack/M5GFX/pull/432#issuecomment-6977090203); no close, no push to the upstream repository, no code changes to m5stack/M5GFX.
The review confirms the macro migration itself from the real headers of every 6.0.x/6.1.1 tag plus v6.3-dev, not from release notes.
Non-blocking suggestions only: compile the new branch in CI (esp32c6/esp32c2 at 6.0.2) and turn the LP fallback into an #error so a future rename cannot silently restore the 32 constant.
